description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.
